name: The BPRD Garbage Truck Stops
description: The BPRD garbage truck slows down and comes to a stop. It sits motionless, engine idling, at the end of the road.
related_events: BPRD garbage truck comes to a stop

name: Guards Patrol Fence with Dogs Under Searchlights
description: Armed guards walk the perimeter of a high-security facility, moving along the fence line with German Shepherds on leashes. Above them, searchlights cut through the darkness, sweeping across the tree line and illuminating patches of the surrounding woods. The beams sweep in steady arcs, casting long shadows as the dogs sniff the ground and strain slightly at their leads. The guards pause occasionally, scanning the darkness beyond the fence before continuing their rounds.
related_events: Guards patrol fence line with German Shepherds
Searchlights sweep surrounding woods

name: Princess Escapes Amid Hellhound Attack
description: As the troll raises his sword, Princess calls out, 'Yrdrig!' The massive hellhound, Yrdrig, bursts from an alcove. With multiple ferocious heads, he lunges at the trolls. Each of his many mouths clamps down on green flesh, lifting and shaking the trolls like rag dolls. In the confusion, the Princess moves quickly, slipping through a secret door and disappearing from sight.
related_events: Princess escapes through secret door
Hellhound Yrdrig attacks trolls

name: Police Surround Building with Helicopters Overhead
description: Sirens wailed as police vehicles converged on the building, officers moving into position around its perimeter. They advanced in tight formation, weapons drawn, securing all exits. Above, two helicopters circled slowly, their rotors cutting through the air, searchlights scanning the roof and surrounding streets. The building was sealed off, with officers on the ground maintaining position and the helicopters maintaining a steady hover overhead.
related_events: Police surround building in tactical formation
Helicopters hover over building during police operation

name: Demolition Begins at West Side Railyards
description: At midnight, heavy machinery moves into the West Side Railyards, tearing down abandoned factories and rail sheds that surround an old roundhouse. Dust and debris rise under the glow of floodlights as steel beams buckle and walls collapse. A nearby sign stands illuminated: COMING NEXT SUMMER, THREE POINTS SHOPPING MALL. The camera passes over the wreckage and settles on a small guard shack near the edge of the site.
related_events: Demolition begins on abandoned factories and rail sheds
related_occasions: Demolition At West Side Railyards

name: Hellboy Scans the Horizon with Schufften Glasses
description: Hellboy, Abe, and Johann stand on the rooftop of a bowling alley, overlooking the distant crowd. Hellboy raises the Schufften glasses to his eyes, scanning the horizon carefully. After a moment, he lowers the glasses and speaks to Sparky. "Nothing yet, Sparky," he says, his voice steady. The city remains still in the distance.
related_events: Hellboy uses Schufften glasses to scan for threats
Hellboy reports no sightings to Sparky

name: Abe and Hellboy Confront Underground Threat
description: Abe and Hellboy hear sounds of movement beneath the ground, coming from unseen creatures burrowing nearby. Abe listens carefully, then warns Hellboy that they should leave immediately and call for backup.
related_events: Unseen creatures create sounds of movement underground
Abe identifies potential threat and recommends retreat

name: BPRD Convoy Crosses Washington Bridge
description: A garbage truck leads a convoy of BPRD vehicles across the Washington Bridge. Other vehicles follow closely behind as they travel toward Chinatown. The city lights reflect off the water below. A sign reads: WASHINGTON BRIDGE 21.00 HOURS.
related_events: BPRD convoy crosses Washington Bridge en route to Chinatown

name: Limousines Arrive on Park Avenue
description: On a rainy evening in mid-December, limousines glide one by one to a stop along Park Avenue in Manhattan. They line up beneath lampposts adorned with twinkling Christmas lights, their tires hissing through slush and wet pavement. The vehicles wait near the entrance of a grand building where a public function is underway, doors opening now and then to let out passengers wrapped in overcoats and evening wear.
related_events: limousines line up for a public function on Park Avenue
related_occasions: Public Function On Park Avenue

name: Prince wounded and curses guards during tunnel escape
description: The Prince runs through a tunnel alongside the Praetorian Guards. Suddenly, he doubles over, clutching his left arm, from which blood is pouring. He shouts in pain and curses at the guards, his voice filled with anger and distress.
related_events: Prince is injured during tunnel escape
Prince curses at Praetorian Guards

name: The Prince and His Guards Flee Through Tunnels as Trolls Scream
description: The Prince and his guards run through narrow tunnel passages, their footsteps echoing against the stone walls. All around them, deep and guttural troll screams reverberate, bouncing off the rock, growing louder and then fading in unpredictable bursts. The air is thick with tension as they press forward, moving quickly through the dim passageways.
related_events: Prince and guards rush through tunnel passages
Troll screams echo through tunnel walls

name: Princess Retrieves Tome and Is Attacked by Trolls
description: The Princess rushes to a small cabinet and pulls out an ancient, leather-bound tome. As she turns to leave, a horde of trolls surges forward, surrounding her completely. One of the trolls swings a heavy, rusty sword, striking her left arm and opening a deep gash.
related_events: Princess retrieves ancient leather-bound tome from cabinet
Trolls surround the Princess
Troll injures Princess with rusty sword

name: Liz and Abe at the Window
description: Liz and Abe move to the window and look down. A television camera lens zooms in on them. Liz speaks into her radio, calling out, 'HB?? HB?? Are you alright??'
related_events: Liz and Abe look down from the window
Television camera zooms in on Liz and Abe
Liz attempts to contact Hellboy via radio

name: Guard Confronted and Defeated by Shadowy Figure
description: Guard 2 strides forward, waving his nightstick. The shadowy figure spins, shedding his coat and drawing a long, thin sword. He slashes through the air, and the guard's shadow on the brick wall is cut into three pieces before collapsing. The guard falls, motionless.
related_events: Guard 2 approaches intruder while waving nightstick
Shadowy figure reveals sword and attacks guard
Guard's shadow is severed and collapses

name: The Prince Discovers the Aftermath in the Princess' Chamber
description: The Prince entered the Princess' chamber and found dead and dying trolls scattered across the floor. He searched the room for his sister but found no trace of her. Clutching his bleeding arm, he stood amidst the carnage.
related_events: Prince discovers dead and dying trolls in Princess' chamber
Prince finds no trace of the Princess
Prince clutches his bleeding arm in pain

name: Hellboy Fights Off Swarming Creatures While Protecting an Agent
description: Hellboy shields a fellow agent as creatures swarm toward them. He fires his shotguns, blasting dozens of the creatures against the walls. With each explosion, more creatures burst from the wall surfaces, swarming into the room. Dozens of the things latch onto Hellboy’s body, crawling over his arms and shoulders. He rips at them with his hands, clawing them away as they cling to him like small animals.
related_events: Hellboy protects fellow agent from attacking creatures
Hellboy fires shotguns at swarming creatures
Creatures emerge from walls in response to gunfire
Hellboy claws at creatures clinging to his body

name: Hellboy Prepares for Siege
description: Hellboy hears a scratching noise and calls out, wondering if there's more than one. Abe responds over the intercom that there are many more—perhaps a hundred or two. As Hellboy approaches a wall, it suddenly bulges and splits open. The ceiling cracks as well. He quickly loads a pair of lever-action shotguns.
related_events: Hellboy hears scratching noise indicating multiple approaching entities
Abe communicates presence of numerous threats via intercom
Wall and ceiling rupture under pressure from approaching entities
Hellboy loads lever-action shotguns in preparation for attack

name: Liz Reveals the Swarm, Mudd Attacked
description: Liz raised her hands, their glow cutting through the darkness and revealing a seething mass of creatures surging across the room. The swarm swarmed over the walls and furniture, tearing at the wallpaper and wood. In an instant, they overtook Agent Mudd, swarming over his body and ripping into him. Abe stumbled backward, eyes wide, as the creatures multiplied and thrashed in every direction.
related_events: Liz illuminates room with glowing hands
Swarm of creatures engulfs room and attacks furniture
Swarm of creatures attacks Agent Mudd
Abe reacts in shock to the creature attack

name: Royal Guards Halt the Travelers, Chamberlain Offers Respectful Escort
description: A dozen Royal Guards in helmets and light armor emerge from a tunnel, blocking the path of the Shadowy Figure and Wink. The two pause as the guards take position. Moments later, the Chamberlain steps forward, bows low before the Shadowy Figure, and says, 'Prince Nuada—He awaits you. Please, follow me, Sire.'
related_events: Royal Guards emerge from tunnel and confront Shadowy Figure and Wink
Chamberlain bows before Shadowy Figure to show respect
Chamberlain announces Prince Nuada's anticipation and invites Shadowy Figure to follow

name: Abe and Hellboy Find the Gnawed Bone and the Floor of Waste
description: Abe picks up a wet, gnawed human femur and mutters that the creatures are vicious and cruel. The floor beneath them shifts slightly. Abe asks if Hellboy has noticed the floor. Hellboy looks around, commenting on what he thinks is a thick, light brown rug underfoot. He lifts his foot and sees it is not a rug but a deep layer of fresh excrement. 'Aw, crap,' he says. Abe confirms the floor is made of waste, explaining that the creatures digest and excrete almost immediately after eating, then feed again. There are no corpses left behind because nothing remains. Hellboy stares at the mess and demands to know what the creatures are.
related_events: Abe discovers a wet and gnawed human femur
Floor movement reveals living layer beneath
Hellboy realizes he is standing on accumulated waste
Abe explains creatures' rapid digestion and excretion cycle
Hellboy demands identification of the creatures

name: Guard Mocks HB on TV, Second Guard Spots Figure at Gate
description: Guard 1 watches television and laughs at HB's appearance, pointing out his heavy red makeup and prominent forehead. Guard 2, silently cleaning his gun, looks up and sees a shadowy figure standing by the gates. He grabs his nightstick and steps outside.
related_events: Guard 1 comments on HB's appearance on television
Guard 2 notices a shadowy figure by the gates

name: Guard 2 Confronts the Shadowy Figure at the Gates
description: Guard 2 sees a shadowy figure standing by the gates. He picks up his nightstick and steps outside the building, moving toward the figure.
related_events: Guard 2 prepares to confront the shadowy figure

name: Hellboy's Transport Through Crowded Streets
description: Agents stretched yellow tape across the street, holding back a crowd of onlookers and reporters. As the garbage truck rumbled forward, people pressed against the barrier, some surging ahead to catch a glimpse of Hellboy inside. A group of supporters and protesters broke into a run alongside the vehicle, waving signs. Inside, Manning told Hellboy to avoid signing autographs. Hellboy refused, saying the garbage truck sent the wrong message about who they were. Manning responded by questioning whether the vehicle was really the issue.
related_events: Agents establish street cordon to control press and bystanders
Bystanders surge forward to catch sight of Hellboy
Supporters and protesters run alongside the truck with signs
Manning advises Hellboy against signing autographs
Hellboy refuses autographs due to negative symbolism of garbage truck
Manning questions Hellboy's focus on transportation over mission

name: Applause After Johann's Speech
description: After Johann finishes speaking, the room falls silent. Then, the reporters begin to clap, followed by the crowd. Liz and Abe join in, their hands coming together in applause. Hellboy stares, wide-eyed and slack-jawed, clearly stunned by the reaction. Abe turns to him, saying Johann has a nice voice. Hellboy looks at Abe, then back at the applauding crowd, still disbelieving.
related_events: Reporters and crowd applaud after moment of silence
Hellboy expresses disbelief at the applause
Abe praises Johann's voice

name: Johann Rejoins the Team
description: After the applause fades, Johann steps away from the crowd, his glass head reflecting the dim light. He walks over to the group, his expression calm and focused. Without hesitation, he says, 'Come on. We have work to do,' and leads them away.
related_events: Johann rejoins the group to resume work

name: Liz Confronts Abe About the Creatures
description: Liz glares at Abe, her voice sharp with impatience. 'Damn it Abe, just tell us!' she snaps. Abe hesitates, then clears his throat. 'They're—um—tooth fairies.' Liz rolls her eyes, disgusted. 'Abe, c'mon—cut the crap.' She looks down, wiping her boot, still sticky with dung. Abe continues, 'Third century, the Teutoburg forest. Famished. They feed on calcium—and they do go for the teeth first.' He pauses. 'How do you think they got that name “Tooth Fairies”??' Liz suddenly freezes, sensing movement in the dark. She holds out her hand, conjures a small flame in her palm, and sweeps the light across the shadows. The fire reveals nothing.
related_events: Liz demands Abe to reveal the truth
Abe reveals the creatures are Tooth Fairies

name: Liz Finds Feces, Senses Movement, and Lights the Dark
description: Liz checks her boots and sees they are sticky with feces. She senses something moving in the darkness around her. Holding out her hand, she creates a small fire in her palm and sweeps the light across the area, revealing nothing.
related_events: Liz discovers feces on her boots
Liz detects movement in the darkness
Liz creates fire in her hand to illuminate the area

name: Liz Confronts Hellboy Over Media Attention
description: Hellboy rides in silence, lost in thought, until he suddenly laughs. He turns to Liz, incredulous. "Me? Threatened? By whom? By him?" Liz responds that it’s not just one person—it’s everything he’s done. The TV appearance, the reporters. Hellboy protests, "I did that?" Liz insists he did, saying he acted without thinking, eager for public attention. Now they’re both in the spotlight. Hellboy shrugs it off. "We got some hate mail. We'll deal with it. Together." He moves closer. "Something else bothering you?" Liz nods quietly. She says she’ll tell him, but not now. She apologizes, then admits she’s never liked being watched. It makes her feel like a freak. Suddenly, angry shouts erupt. Fists pound on walls and car fenders. The doors burst open, flooding the space with reporters, TV crews, cameras, and flashing lights—hundreds of them, from Japan, the UK, Germany, and beyond.
related_events: Hellboy reacts with disbelief to being considered a threat
Liz confronts Hellboy about his public actions
Liz expresses discomfort about being watched

name: Hellboy and Liz Confront the Media Swarm
description: Hellboy and Liz stand together as they are suddenly surrounded by a crowd of reporters and TV crews from around the world. Cameras flash and voices shout as the press surges toward them. Hellboy, unfazed, shrugs and mentions the hate mail they’ve received, saying they’ll deal with it—together. The crowd presses in, capturing every moment, while Liz remains quiet, uneasy under the weight of so many watching eyes.
related_events: Hellboy shrugs off hate mail as something to handle together
Reporters and TV crews swarm Hellboy and Liz

name: Abe, Liz, and Agent Mudd Investigate the Auction Site
description: Abe, Liz, and Agent Mudd moved cautiously toward the overturned auctioneer's podium. Abe spotted an empty iron cage and noticed the Royal Seal embossed on its door. A high-pitched chitter-chatter reached his ears, though he saw nothing. As Liz and Agent Mudd examined the other cages, Abe spread his webbed fingers, alert. 'What kind of creature?' Liz asked. 'Creatures,' Abe replied, his voice low. 'I detect multiple creatures nearby.'
related_events: Abe, Liz, and Agent Mudd approach the overturned auctioneer's podium
Abe discovers an empty cage with the Royal Seal
Abe detects high-pitched chitterchatter from an unseen source
Abe extends his webbed fingers while investigating the cages
Liz inquires about the type of creature present
Abe indicates detection of multiple creatures

name: Manning Addresses Reporters After Customs Incident
description: Manning stands on the sidewalk, speaking to a crowd of reporters under flashing camera lights. He declares the situation under control, explaining that customs agents earlier discovered a few illegally imported items, which led to a minor confrontation. Federal agents have since taken over the premises. He instructs the reporters to step back, then acknowledges a young female reporter, smiling as he calls her by name.
related_events: Customs agents discover illegally imported items
Minor confrontation occurs at customs site
Federal agents take control of the premises
Manning addresses reporters at sidewalk press conference
related_occasions: Sidewalk Press Conference

name: Hellboy Breaches Wall, Uncovering Fleeing Creatures
description: Hellboy fires his weapon at a corridor wall, blasting open a large hole. Plaster and debris spill into the hallway as cracks spread outward. From within the newly opened space, small, creature-like forms emerge, quickly burrowing into the walls and fleeing the scene. Hellboy peers inside, watching them escape, and calls out in response.
related_events: Hellboy shoots through wall creating large opening
Small burrowing creatures flee through wall opening

name: Liz Arms Herself and Team Moves to Garage
description: Surrounded by racks of weapons, Abe, Hellboy, and Liz finish suiting up. Liz, wearing black army pants and a leather jacket, loads an automatic handgun and secures it in her utility belt. The team heads into a vast garage filled with planes, cars, boats, helicopters, and tanks. They approach their usual transport—a garbage truck—and begin loading weapons and ammunition aboard. Hellboy holds the door open for Liz as they prepare to depart. The truck's engine starts, headlights cutting through the dark as night settles in.
related_events: Liz prepares for mission by arming herself with handgun
Team members gather and move to the garage

name: Loading Up and Boarding the Garbage Truck
description: Abe, Hellboy, and Liz moved through the vast garage, loading weapons and ammunition onto their modified garbage truck. Racks of gear were secured inside as Liz climbed in, her black army pants and leather jacket catching the dim light. Hellboy stood by the open door, holding it for her without a word. Once she was aboard, he followed, and the engine roared to life. Headlights cut through the dark as the truck sat ready, parked among planes, cars, and tanks in the cavernous space.
related_events: Team loads weapons and ammunition onto garbage truck
Hellboy holds truck door open for Liz

name: Start the Garbage Truck and Leave
description: The engine of the garbage truck rumbles to life. Headlights cut through the dark garage, illuminating the row of vehicles. The truck pulls forward, leaving the armory behind as it rolls toward the exit.
related_events: Garbage truck engine starts and headlights activate

name: Through the Basement and a Couple of Suggestions
description: The bag lady moved through the rear of the bowling alley and opened a basement door. The room rumbled with the sound of rolling balls and falling pins. Hellboy whispered, "Maybe we can bowl a few frames, uh?" Abe spread his webbed fingers and said, "Bowling balls—they give me trouble." Hellboy turned and said, "How about a beer, then? Now that we're 'out'—Whaddya say, Mein Herr?" Johann replied, "Sorry. I don't drink." Hellboy exhaled. "Sheesh—"
related_events: Bag lady enters basement through rear of bowling alley
Hellboy suggests bowling a few frames
Abe displays webbed fingers and expresses difficulty with bowling balls
Hellboy offers beer to Johann

name: Johann Declines a Beer
description: After Hellboy suggests getting a beer now that they're out, Johann replies that he doesn't drink. The moment passes quietly, with no further response from the others.
related_events: Johann declines beer offer

name: Guests Arrive at the Exhibition
description: Under black umbrellas, wealthy men and women step out of limousines and approach a stately ten-story building. They walk up to the entrance and present gleaming golden invitations to the security personnel stationed at the door. The sign on the facade reads: TONIGHT - TREASURES OF PRE-CHRISTIAN EUROPE.
related_events: Guests arrive at the building under black umbrellas
Guests present golden invitations to security
related_occasions: Treasures Of Pre-Christian Europe Exhibition Opening

name: The Infiltration Begins
description: Under the cover of darkness, a Shadowy Figure stands in an alley beside an eight-foot-tall troll named Wink. Wink has grey skin, a deep scar over his left eye socket, and a heavy iron mace where his right hand should be. The Shadowy Figure speaks in Elvish, his voice low, giving instructions. He steps back, spreads his arms wide, and begins scaling the building like a bat, climbing swiftly up the wall. Five floors above the ground, he continues his ascent, while Wink remains below, waiting.
related_events: Shadowy figure speaks to Wink in Elvish
Shadowy Figure climbs the building wall like a bat
related_occasions: Treasures Of Pre-Christian Europe Exhibition Opening

name: Auction of the Pre-Celtic Votive Sculpture
description: The auctioneer stands before the stone fertility goddess, a granite Pre-Celtic votive sculpture dated to 700 B.C. Dressed in formal wear, he opens the bidding at two hundred thousand dollars. A distinguished buyer raises his hand, offering two hundred seventy-five thousand. The auctioneer acknowledges the bid and quickly announces a new offer of three hundred thousand from Mr. Van Hausen. Moments later, a female bidder lifts her hand, and the auctioneer confirms a bid of three hundred fifty thousand dollars from Mrs. Bernstein. As the bidding continues, a steward quietly leaves the room and walks down the hall.
related_events: Auctioneer opens bidding at two hundred thousand dollars
Distinguished Buyer bids two hundred seventy-five thousand dollars
Auctioneer acknowledges bid of three hundred thousand dollars from Mr. Van Hausen
Female bidder raises hand to place bid
Auctioneer acknowledges bid of three hundred fifty thousand dollars from Mrs. Bernstein
related_occasions: Auction Of A Pre-Celtic Votive Sculpture

name: Steward Exits During Auction Bidding
description: The camera focuses on a granite fertility goddess sculpture from circa 700 B.C., illuminated under the hall's lights. The auctioneer, dressed in formal attire, stands at the podium, announcing bids as monitors display close-up views of the statue for the guests. 'Three hundred thousand once,' he says, as a distinguished buyer raises his hand. 'And three hundred and fifty thousand, thank you, Mrs. Bernstein.' Amid the rising bids, a steward in formal livery steps away from his position, turns, and walks out of the auction hall through a side door, leaving the room as the bidding continues.
related_events: Steward leaves auction hall during ongoing auction
related_occasions: Auction Of A Pre-Celtic Votive Sculpture

name: Manning Learns the Truth About the Cats
description: Manning gasps, 'Oh, dear Lord,' and falls silent. He asks what happened to the cats. Liz replies, 'She eats them.' Manning stares, stunned. 'She? That's a she?????' Hellboy steps forward, saying, 'We're moving in, Sparky,' as he, Johann, and Abe follow the Bag Lady toward a service door leading into a corridor.
related_events: Manning expresses distress over the cats
Liz reveals that 'she' eats the cats
Manning reacts with shock to the female designation
related_occasions: Operation To Follow The Bag Lady

name: Hellboy Leads Team Through Urban Chase to Hidden Corridor
description: Hellboy signals the team to move forward. He, Johann, and Abe follow the Bag Lady through a bowling alley, a back alley, and under a bridge. The Bag Lady stops at a service door and opens it. They enter the corridor behind her.
related_events: Hellboy announces the team is moving in
Hellboy, Johann, and Abe follow the Bag Lady
Bag Lady opens a service door
related_occasions: Operation To Follow The Bag Lady

name: Hellboy Finds Liz in the Cage
description: Hellboy enters a room teeming with hissing creatures crawling over iron cages. For a moment, he doesn't see Liz and calls out in panic. He hears a faint scream in response. Swinging his shotgun, he fights his way forward, batting the creatures aside. He reaches a cage surrounded by small beasts gnawing at the bars. Inside, Liz cowers, trapped. Their eyes meet. They share a quiet, wordless moment. Hellboy urges her to act. Liz closes her eyes, whispers that the fire is not her enemy, and becomes enveloped in blue flame. The flame spreads gently over her, then erupts into a fiery explosion.
related_events: Hellboy reacts with panic upon initially not finding Liz
Hellboy fights through creatures with a shotgun
Hellboy discovers Liz trapped in a cage surrounded by creatures
Hellboy exchanges a silent moment of connection with Liz

name: Liz Unleashes Her Fire
description: Hellboy shouts for Liz as creatures swarm the room. He hears her faint scream and fights his way forward, spotting a cage surrounded by beasts. Inside, Liz cowers, their eyes meeting in a silent moment. Hellboy urges her, 'Do it, Liz, do it!!!' She closes her eyes and whispers, 'The fire's not my enemy. It is part of me.' A soft blue flame spreads over her skin. Abe mutters, 'Uh-oh,' and takes cover. The flame grows, pulsing with heat, as Liz breathes, 'It is mine.' The fire erupts in a massive explosion, engulfing the space in a blinding burst of energy.
related_events: Liz whispers affirmation about her connection to fire
Abe reacts with concern as Liz's power escalates
Liz's flame erupts into a fiery explosion

name: Hellboy Battles the Smoldering Fairies
description: Smoldering fairies climb out of a smoking crater, snarling at the crowd. One leaps toward a woman, but Hellboy fires, shooting it mid-air. He quickly shoots the others, dropping them one by one. A final creature clings to his coat; he plucks it off, holding it up by the tail. Manning rushes forward as camera flashes erupt around Hellboy, who stands amid the smoke and wreckage, unharmed.
related_events: Smoldering fairies emerge from crater and threaten crowd
Hellboy shoots attacking fairy mid-leap
Hellboy eliminates remaining fairies
Hellboy removes and holds up last creature

name: Hellboy Exposed to the Public
description: After the smoldering fairies lie dead, a crowd surrounds the scene, their camera flashes bursting toward Hellboy as he stands amid the smoke and debris, grinning. He turns to Manning, who rushes forward, his face pale with disbelief. Hellboy shrugs and says, "Gee whiz, Manning—I guess we're out now."
related_events: Camera flashes illuminate grinning Hellboy
Hellboy speaks to Manning with a shrug
Manning approaches scene in shock

name: Liz Activates the Schufften Device
description: The BPRD truck sits parked behind the bowling alley, its back door open. Inside, Liz speaks into the radio, her voice calm but focused. 'I read you, Red. Keep looking.' Manning stands nearby, glancing at his watch, then at the strange optical device. 'Looking at what, for goodness sake? What do these things do?' Liz doesn't answer right away. She adjusts a series of lenses and prisms on the Schufften glasses, turning knobs with practiced hands. Outside, Hellboy's voice crackles over the radio. 'Hey, Sparky, I think we got one.' Manning turns to the monitor, watching a hunched bag lady push a shopping cart filled with cats. 'That? Oh, please, she looks as sweet as she can.' Liz steps closer to the screen. 'Red, turn on the antiglamour filter.' She explains, 'Fairy folk use a spell called glamour to seem human and nice.' As Hellboy adjusts the goggles, the image shifts—filters layer over the view, and the bag lady's form twists, revealing a hulking, muscle-bound troll beneath.
related_events: Liz communicates with Red via radio from BPRD truck
Liz operates optical device with lenses and prisms
Manning expresses boredom and questions the purpose of the search

name: Abe Explains the Schufften Glasses
description: Abe stands near the BPRD truck, wearing a set of unusual goggles with multiple lenses. He begins to speak, recounting how Emil Schufften, a friend of Benjamin Franklin, designed the optical devices in 1778. According to Abe, Schufften created them with the intention of photographing fairies in England. As he talks, Liz adjusts a series of lenses and prisms on her own set of the glasses. Manning picks up a pair, curious, and listens. The equipment hums faintly as it powers up, ready to reveal what lies beneath magical appearances.
related_events: Abe explains historical origin of Schufften optical gear

name: Hellboy Uncovers Troll with Antiglamour Filter
description: Hellboy calls out from the parking lot, reporting a possible fairy folk sighting. Liz, inside the BPRD truck, tells him to turn on the antiglamour filter. Through the goggles, the image shifts as the lenses adjust. The bag lady pushing a shopping cart full of cats transforms in appearance, revealing a hulking, muscle-bound troll beneath the illusion.
related_events: Hellboy alerts Manning about a potential fairy folk sighting
Liz instructs Red to activate the antiglamour filter
Optical device reveals bag lady's true form as a troll

name: Hellboy Confronts Manning Over Leadership Change
description: Hellboy walks through the SECURITY POUND, rows of caged creatures surrounding him as BPRD agents move between the pens. He studies Manning, who appears tense and uneasy. Hellboy asks if Manning no longer trusts him. Manning replies that he never did, and says that after the previous night's events, Washington has decided on a new public face for the BPRD. Hellboy reacts with disbelief, asking what is wrong with his face—or Manning's, for that matter—pointing out that the press loves him. Manning ignores the comment and consults a file, revealing the replacement's name: Johann Kraus. Hellboy reacts sharply at the mention of a German, expressing discomfort. Manning continues, listing Kraus's credentials—a physical medium, head of the European branch, a doctor in philosophy and occult practice from the University of Munich, and a skilled speaker. Hellboy interrupts, reiterating his unease around Germans. Manning remarks that Washington wants someone with a trustworthy appearance. They approach a steel cage where Johann Kraus stands. Kraus is about six feet tall, wearing a canvas containment suit lined with tubes and valves. His hands are covered in thick latex gloves with fingertip valves, and his head is a translucent glass bubble filled with swirling gas. He studies a drawing of the royal seal from the Fairy Cages. Kraus turns and approaches Liz, takes her hand, and bows. His voice is smooth and warm. Liz smiles. Hellboy glowers as Kraus's glass head turns toward him and Manning.
related_events: Hellboy confronts Manning about loss of trust
Manning reveals Johann Kraus as new public face of BPRD
related_occasions: Bprd Personnel Transition Meeting

name: Hellboy Reacts to Johann Kraus's Introduction
description: Hellboy stands in the SECURITY POUND, surrounded by caged creatures and patrolling BPRD agents. Manning appears tense as Hellboy questions whether he’s lost his trust. Manning explains that after the previous night’s events, Washington wants a new public face for the Bureau. Hellboy protests, pointing to his own face and then to Manning’s, insisting the press loves him. Manning cuts in, revealing the replacement is Johann Kraus, head of the European branch. At the mention of the name, Hellboy recoils, muttering that Kraus is German and that Germans make him nervous. Manning continues reading from a file, listing Kraus’s credentials—a physical medium, doctor of philosophy and occult practice, an eloquent speaker—but Hellboy overlaps each point with renewed complaints about Germans. They approach a steel cage where Johann Kraus stands. He is tall, wearing a canvas containment suit lined with tubes and valves, his hands covered in thick latex gloves, his head a translucent glass bubble filled with swirling gas. Kraus studies a drawing of the royal seal from the Fairy Cages. He notices Liz, takes her hand, and bows. 'Johann Kraus, at your service,' he says, his voice smooth and warm. Liz smiles. Hellboy glowers. As Kraus turns his glass head toward them, Hellboy whispers to Manning, 'That’s an open face for you…'
related_events: Hellboy expresses discomfort with German associates
Hellboy reacts with discomfort to Johann Kraus's appearance
related_occasions: Bprd Personnel Transition Meeting

name: Johann Kraus Greets the Team
description: Johann Kraus approaches Liz and extends his hand. He bows slightly as he takes her hand in greeting. His glass head, filled with swirling gas, turns toward her as he speaks in a smooth, warm voice. 'Johann Kraus, at your service.' Liz smiles in response. Hellboy stands nearby, watching silently, his expression dark and unyielding.
related_events: Johann Kraus greets Liz with a bow and handshake
related_occasions: Bprd Personnel Transition Meeting

name: Prince Refuses to Surrender Sword at Chamber Entrance
description: The Chamberlain leads the Prince down a tunnel lined with guards. At an intersection, the armed men form a perimeter around the Prince. The Chamberlain requests that the Prince surrender his sword before entering the chamber to see the king, stating it is protocol for all, regardless of rank. The Prince refuses. The Chamberlain warns that without compliance, the Prince may not see his father. After a tense pause, the Prince remains firm in his refusal.
related_events: Armed guards surround Prince at tunnel intersection
Chamberlain enforces protocol requiring sword surrender
Prince refuses to surrender sword at chamber entrance
related_occasions: Royal Audience With The King

name: The Prince Surrenders His Sword
description: The Prince hesitates at the intersection, hand on his sword as the Chamberlain insists he lay it down before entering the chamber. After a tense silence, he releases the weapon. The guards take the sword and carefully search him. Once cleared, the Prince is led forward through the large, rusting iron door.
related_events: Prince relinquishes sword after moment of tension
Guards search Prince after weapon surrender
related_occasions: Royal Audience With The King

name: The Prince Enters the Chamber, Leaving Wink Behind
description: The Prince hands over his sword to the guards, who inspect him before allowing him to proceed. Wink remains at the entrance, unwilling to give up his weapon. The guards do not challenge Wink’s presence but make it clear he cannot enter. As the rusting iron door creaks open, the Prince steps forward alone and is escorted through into the chamber.
related_events: Wink refuses to surrender weapon and remains at entrance
Prince is escorted through iron door into chamber
related_occasions: Royal Audience With The King

name: Hellboy Fights Creatures in the Sales Room
description: Hellboy storms into the sales room, stomping down on creatures and blasting them with the butt of his shotgun. Flames burst up as the creatures regroup and lunge at him again. Liz and Abe rush toward the stairs, calling out to Hellboy. He kicks the creatures away, keeps shooting, then drops his backpack and pulls out a belt of Vulcan grenades. Holding the belt high, he draws the creatures toward the windows. As they swarm over him, he pulls the pins. Liz yells for him to move, but the grenades detonate in a massive explosion. Hellboy is launched through the window in a ball of fire, flying out into the night and crashing into the street below, still surrounded by burning, writhing creatures.
related_events: Hellboy attacks creatures in sales room with shotgun and grenades
Liz and Abe flee toward stairs during creature attack

name: Hellboy Lures Fairies to Window and Detonates Grenades
description: Hellboy kicks aside the attacking creatures and continues firing his shotgun. He drops his backpack and pulls out a belt of Vulcan 66 grenades, holding it high. As flames rise around him, he draws the tooth fairies toward the windows facing the street. The creatures swarm onto him. Liz shouts a warning from the stairs. Before she can finish, Hellboy pulls the pins. A massive explosion erupts. Shattered glass and fire burst outward. He flies through the air, a flaming figure, crashing onto the pavement below surrounded by writhing fairies. The crowd scatters as the ground cracks beneath his impact.
related_events: Hellboy lures tooth fairies to window before detonating grenades
Liz yells a warning to Hellboy as explosion occurs

name: Hellboy Ejected Through Window and Crashes into Street
description: A massive explosion erupts inside the auction house, hurling Hellboy through the upper floor window like a cannonball. A ball of flame and covered in writhing fairies, he arcs through the air and slams into the street below. The impact cracks the pavement, sending onlookers scrambling in all directions.
related_events: Hellboy is launched through upper floor window by explosion
Hellboy crashes into street, cracking pavement and scattering onlookers

name: Manning Shouts After Reporters Who Flee the Explosion
description: A ball of fire erupts from an upstairs balcony, startling the crowd and reporters below. The reporters immediately turn and rush toward the explosion, abandoning Manning. He stands alone, shouting after them, 'Hey guys, hey guys, come back!!'
related_events: Manning calls out to departing reporters in frustration
Explosion erupts from upstairs balcony startling crowd and reporters

name: Suiting Up for the Mission
description: Hellboy, Liz, and Abe began gearing up for the mission. As they prepared, Abe pulled out a pair of prototype composite goggles made of copper and glass, their components buzzing and whirring. He put one pair on to test them, adjusting to the fit and function. The team moved with purpose, finalizing their equipment in anticipation of the operation ahead.
related_events: Hellboy, Liz, and Abe prepare for deployment
Abe tests prototype composite goggles

name: Hellboy Questions the Search
description: Hellboy mutters in frustration, angry at being seen as a target, and scoffs at the idea that someone thinks he's important. He points out that they've been searching for a location for years without finding it, then turns to Abe, waiting for a response. Abe pulls out two headsets made of copper and glass, humming with internal mechanisms, and tries one on. Hellboy stands silent for a moment, watching, then falls into thought as the others move toward the garbage truck.
related_events: Hellboy expresses frustration about being targeted
Hellboy questions the futility of their search

name: Hellboy Reacts to the Newcomer
description: Liz mentions that the newcomer might be staying for good. She comments on his nice voice, and Abe agrees, describing it as both commanding and soothing. Hellboy stares in disbelief, scoffing at the idea of the newcomer remaining. He calls the newcomer a jerk and mocks Abe, accusing him of being a suck-up for liking him. The tension hangs in the air as they prepare to move out.
related_events: Liz suggests the newcomer might stay permanently
Abe and Liz praise the newcomer's voice
Hellboy reacts with disbelief to the newcomer's presence
Hellboy insults the newcomer and mocks Abe

name: Hellboy Stays Behind
description: The team moved toward the garbage truck where Manning and Abe were waiting. As they walked, Liz remarked that Hellboy seemed threatened by the newcomer. Hellboy did not respond. He stayed behind, standing alone, lost in thought.
related_events: Team moves toward the garbage truck to regroup
Liz suggests Hellboy feels threatened by the newcomer
Hellboy remains behind to reflect on the situation

name: Johann Revives a Dead Fairy to Uncover Its Past
description: Johann pulled one of the dead, singed Fairies from its containment. Hellboy and the others gathered around as he adjusted the valves at the tips of his fingers. Without using an amulet, he released a protoplasmic emanation from his fingertips, which entered the body of the Fairy. The creature suddenly snarled, baring its teeth at Hellboy. Another Fairy in a nearby pen reacted the same way. Johann explained that he had briefly reactivated the neural system, allowing the Fairy to remember. The Fairy jabbered furiously, glaring at Hellboy. Johann translated: the Fairy called him rude, brutish, and not too bright. Abe remarked, 'Touche.' The Fairy continued chattering in high-pitched bursts. Johann then said the creature remembered a peculiar noise—market sounds in Troll language. Liz asked if he meant the troll market. Johann confirmed. The Fairy grew agitated, then pale and weak. Johann said he was losing control of its limbic system and that the creature was about to die. The Fairy collapsed, its cheekbones hollowing as ectoplasm seeped out and returned to Johann’s fingertips.
related_events: Johann extracts a dead, singed Fairy from containment
Johann uses protoplasmic emanation to reactivate a dead Fairy's neural system
Reanimated Fairy snarls and bares teeth at Hellboy
Reanimated Fairy verbally accuses Hellboy of being rude and brutish
Johann identifies a peculiar noise in the Fairy's memory as Troll language
Group concludes the Fairies were traded at the troll market
related_occasions: Investigation Into The Origin Of Smuggled Fairies

name: Johann Reveals the Troll Market Location
description: Johann examined the dead fairy, then turned to the others. 'Trolls dwell under bridges,' he said. 'Vladimir Vanya, an 18th-century occultist, placed the market under Washington Bridge.' Abe frowned. 'We've looked there before—staked it out for weeks.' Johann moved toward a large crate marked 'Lot 336' and pried it open. 'This time, we have the Schufftein glasses—on loan from the Smithsonian.' He pulled out the glasses and held up the sketch of the Royal Seal. 'And this clue.' Hellboy raised his hand. 'If you're really German, how come you don't have a funny accent?' Johann sighed. 'Get ready. We are on the move.'
related_events: Johann reveals Washington Bridge as a potential location of the Troll market
Johann unveils special equipment from crate labeled 'Lot 336'
Johann presents the Royal Seal sketch as a key clue
Hellboy questions Johann's lack of German accent
Johann signals the team to prepare for departure
related_occasions: Investigation Into The Origin Of Smuggled Fairies

name: The Fairy's Collapse During Reanimation
description: Johann reanimates a dead Fairy, its body twitching to life as ectoplasmic tendrils extend from his fingertips into the creature. The Fairy snarls, baring its teeth, and begins to babble furiously. As Johann maintains the connection, the Fairy grows increasingly agitated, then weak. Its cheekbones hollow, its body pale and trembling. Johann grimaces, stating he is losing control. The Fairy lets out a final shudder and collapses. A wisp of ectoplasm escapes its lifeless form and retreats back to Johann’s fingers, coiling briefly before vanishing.
related_events: Fairy exhibits signs of distress and collapses due to unstable reanimation
related_occasions: Investigation Into The Origin Of Smuggled Fairies

name: WINK Attacks Guard 1 at the Shack
description: Guard 1 sits inside the shack, focused on a game show playing on the television. Outside, WINK appears at the window. Without warning, its massive arm smashes through the wall, seizing Guard 1 and yanking him away. In one swift motion, WINK drives its iron mace into the ground with tremendous force, the impact echoing through the still air.
related_events: Guard 1 tunes in to a game show while on duty
WINK appears behind Guard 1 at the window
WINK punches through the wall and grabs Guard 1
WINK slams his iron mace into the ground

name: Shadowy Figure Kills Guard 2 and Enters the Roundhouse
description: The Shadowy Figure swings his sword, cutting down Guard 2. He wipes the blade clean on the crumpled remains as screams and the sound of bones breaking fill the air. Without pause, he vaults over the chainlink fence and walks into the roundhouse.
related_events: Shadowy Figure kills Guard 2 with his sword

name: WINK Emerges and Breaches the Fence in Pursuit
description: After the guard crumples under the force of a massive iron mace, WINK steps out from behind the shack, his full form now visible in the dim light. Without hesitation, he strides toward the chainlink fence, raises his enormous arm, and smashes through the metal. The fence tears open as WINK forces his way through, following the path taken by the Shadowy Figure.
related_events: WINK emerges from behind the shack
WINK smashes through the chainlink fence

name: Shadowy Figure Enters the Roundhouse
description: The Shadowy Figure vaults over the chainlink fence and walks into the roundhouse. WINK emerges from behind the shack, smashes through the fence, and follows him inside.
related_events: Shadowy Figure vaults over the chainlink fence

name: Team Enters Building and Searches for Survivors
description: The BPRD team steps out of their truck and moves into the building. Abe, Liz, and Agent Mudd enter the dark sales room, scanning the area with night-vision devices. Overturned chairs and scattered debris mark the room's disarray. Liz reports over the intercom that there is no one inside—no survivors, no bodies, nothing. Meanwhile, Hellboy walks down the adjacent corridor, flashlight in hand, stopping to examine a shattered display case. Glass fragments glitter on the floor around it. He calls out to confirm the situation matches what they’ve found elsewhere.
related_events: Hellboy, Abe, and Liz exit the truck and enter the building
Abe, Liz, and Agent Mudd enter the dark sales room with night-vision scanners
Hellboy examines broken display case in the corridor
Liz reports no presence of survivors or bodies in the sales room

name: Hellboy Apologizes to Liz Over Intercom During Mission
description: While moving through the darkened sales room, Hellboy uses the intercom to speak privately with Liz. He begins by mistakenly calling her 'babe,' then quickly corrects himself, whispering an apology. He promises to clean their home when they return, even offering to clean the bathroom. Liz tells him that isn't the problem and that he knows it. Hellboy whispers a question, but she cuts him off, insisting they not discuss it now.
related_events: Hellboy mistakenly addresses Liz over intercom
Hellboy whispers apology and domestic promise to Liz
Liz rejects Hellboy's assumptions about their relationship issue
Liz insists on postponing relationship discussion during mission

name: Manning and Hellboy Prepare for the Mission
description: Manning stands near a truck, holding a bank of monitors and a large digital world map tracking Paranormals. He expresses concern about the crowds in midtown Manhattan and asks Hellboy to be careful and use discretion during the mission. Hellboy assures him it will be easy—he’ll be in and out without being seen, giving his word. Manning offers him a cigar and lights one for him. As Hellboy makes his promise, Liz lets out a sarcastic laugh. Hellboy glares in her direction. They exit the truck and enter the building, while Manning sighs behind them.
related_events: Manning offers cigars to Hellboy and lights one for him
Hellboy assures Manning of his discretion during the mission
Liz sarcastically reacts to Hellboy's claim of discretion

name: Steward Investigates the Open Window
description: The steward notices an open window at the end of the dim corridor and moves toward it. He leans out, looking down at the snow-covered alley ten stories below. The wind is still. The alley lies quiet beneath the falling snow.
related_events: Steward notices open window at end of corridor
Steward leans out window and looks down ten stories

name: Shadowy Figure Attacks the Steward at the Window
description: The Shadowy Figure clings to the smooth granite wall above the open window, hidden in the darkness. As the steward leans out, the Figure lunges downward with terrifying speed, slamming a hand over the man's mouth. The steward's mouth vanishes beneath the grip. Without hesitation, the Figure grabs the steward by the lapels, pulls him through the window, and dangles him over the ten-story drop. Below, a snow-covered alley lies quiet, the spiked wrought-iron fence waiting. The Figure speaks a quiet remark, then releases the steward. The man plummets silently, flailing, until he impales on the fence below. The Figure slips through the window and moves into the corridor.
related_events: Shadowy figure appears above window frame clinging to wall
Shadowy figure lunges and silences steward

name: Shadowy Figure Removes the Steward's Mouth
description: The Shadowy Figure lunges at the steward, clamping a hand over his mouth with terrifying speed. When the hand pulls away, the steward's mouth is gone—vanished without a trace. The Figure seizes the man by his lapels, hauls him through the window, and dangles him over the ten-story drop. Below, a snow-covered alley lies silent, broken only by the sharp spikes of a wrought-iron fence. The Figure speaks in a low tone: 'A silent human—almost as good as a dead one... (BEAT) Almost.' Then he lets go. The steward plummets, flailing soundlessly, until he impales on the fence below. The Figure slips back through the window and moves into the corridor.
related_events: Shadowy figure removes steward's mouth

name: Shadowy Figure Dangles and Drops the Steward
description: The Shadowy Figure grabs the steward by the lapels and pulls him through the window, hoisting him over the edge of the ten-story building. Below, a snow-covered alley lies quiet, broken only by the sharp points of a wrought-iron fence. The Figure speaks a single phrase into the night—'A silent human—almost as good as a dead one... (BEAT) Almost'—before releasing his grip. The steward falls without a sound, limbs flailing, until he strikes the fence below and is impaled. The Shadowy Figure slips back through the window and moves into the corridor.
related_events: Shadowy figure hauls steward outside and dangles him over the void
Shadowy figure speaks cryptic words about silent humans
Steward plummets and impales on spiked fence

name: Shadowy Figure Returns Through Window
description: After the steward's body falls from the window and vanishes into the snow-covered alley below, the Shadowy Figure pulls himself back through the open window and into the darkened corridor. He lands silently on the floor, straightens, and continues down the hallway, moving deeper into the building.
related_events: Shadowy figure enters corridor through window

name: Hellboy Digs Through Rubble for Burned Music Media
description: Hellboy stumbles through the rubble, surrounded by smoke, pulling out blackened LPs and 8-track cassettes. He holds up the damaged records and tapes, sifting through the wreckage to salvage what he can. Liz appears, stepping into view with a glow of blue flame around her. He pulls more albums from a garbage bin, brushing off debris. She points out that he owns the same album on multiple formats, including an 8-track. He insists that Al Green can't be properly listened to on CD and claims 8-track was the superior format. Liz interrupts, frustrated, saying she needs space, just enough to find her toothbrush. As she flares up, losing control, Hellboy gestures behind her, telling her the toothbrush is right there, near the cat food. She turns, sees it, and picks it up from a pile of spilled kibble, grimacing. Before she can continue, an alarm sounds. Hellboy grins, relieved.
related_events: Hellboy retrieves blackened LPs and 8-track cassettes from rubble

name: Liz Confronts Hellboy About His Music Collection
description: Liz appears, surrounded by a shimmering blue flame, and sees Hellboy holding a collection of blackened LPs and 8-track cassettes pulled from the rubble. She points out that he owns the same album on CD, LP, and 8-track. Hellboy insists that Al Green cannot be properly listened to on a CD, declaring that 8-track is the superior format and that one day humanity will realize its mistake.
related_events: Liz confronts Hellboy about his music collection duplicates
Hellboy declares 8-track superior for listening to Al Green

name: Liz Searches for Her Toothbrush and Flares Up
description: HB stumbles through the rubble, surrounded by smoke, holding a collection of blackened LPs and 8-track cassettes. He pulls more records from a garbage bin, insisting that Al Green can't be properly listened to on CD and praising 8-track as the superior format. Liz appears, glowing with blue flame, and complains that she needs space—just enough to find her toothbrush. As her frustration grows, she flares up, losing control. Hellboy interrupts, pointing out her toothbrush is behind her, among the spilled cat food. She turns, sees it, and retrieves it with a look of disgust. Before she can say more, an alarm sounds, and Hellboy reacts with delight.
related_events: Liz expresses frustration about lack of personal space
Liz loses control and flares up emotionally

name: Liz Finds Her Toothbrush in the Cat Food
description: Hellboy calls out to Liz, pointing behind her where her toothbrush lies among a pile of spilled cat kibble. She turns, sees it, and reaches down with a grimace, pulling the toothbrush from the scattered food.
related_events: Hellboy points out location of Liz's toothbrush among cat food
Liz retrieves toothbrush from spilled cat kibble

name: Liz confronts Hellboy about being ignored
description: After retrieving her toothbrush from the spilled cat food, Liz turns to Hellboy, her voice rising. She tells him he acts as if she isn't even there, that he doesn't make space for her—any kind of space. Her hands flicker with blue flame as she speaks, the heat rising around her. Hellboy looks at her, taken aback, as the alarm continues to blare in the background.
related_events: Liz accuses Hellboy of disregarding her presence

name: Alarm Interrupts Argument Between Liz and Hellboy
description: A sudden alarm blares, cutting through the argument between Liz and Hellboy. Hellboy's expression shifts instantly, a wide grin spreading across his face as he turns toward the sound, clearly relieved and energized by the interruption.
related_events: Alarm sounds, interrupting argument between Liz and Hellboy
Hellboy reacts with joy to the sounding alarm

name: Agent Marble Approaches the Creature
description: Agent MARBLE notices a small creature, about nine inches tall with olive skin and almond-shaped eyes, peering out from a crack in the wall. It whimpers softly. MARBLE reaches out toward it, speaking gently. He asks if it is scared. As he moves closer, the creature suddenly snarls, lunges at his hand, and bites his finger. It then darts under his shirt. MARBLE gasps and drops his gun. More creatures crawl out of the crack and climb into his clothing. He tears open his shirt as the creatures attack. Ribs crack. Blood sprays. MARBLE collapses to the ground.
related_events: Agent MARBLE discovers a small creature peering from a wall crack
Agent MARBLE attempts to comfort the frightened creature

name: Hellboy Warns Marble About the Fairy
description: Hellboy sees Agent Marble approaching the small creature peering from the crack in the wall. Recognizing it as a Fairy, he calls out urgently from across the room, warning Marble to stop. His voice cuts through the stillness just as Marble reaches out toward the creature.
related_events: Hellboy warns Agent MARBLE not to approach the Fairy

name: Fairy Attacks Agent MARBLE and Initiates Violent Assault
description: The small creature suddenly snarls, leaps at Agent MARBLE, and bites his finger. It then dives under his shirt, attacking from within. Dozens of similar creatures emerge from the crack in the wall and crawl into MARBLE's clothing. He gasps, tears open his shirt as claws and teeth tear into his skin. His ribs crack, blood spurts, and he collapses to the ground.
related_events: Fairy attacks Agent MARBLE and bites his finger
Fairy crawls under Agent MARBLE's shirt and begins attacking internally

name: Creatures Overwhelm Agent MARBLE
description: Dozens of small creatures burst from a crack in the wall and scramble into Agent MARBLE's clothing. He gasps, drops his gun, and frantically tears open his shirt as the creatures bite and claw at his body. Ribs crack, blood spurts, and MARBLE collapses to the ground, motionless.
related_events: Multiple creatures emerge from the wall crack and infest Agent MARBLE's clothing
Agent MARBLE tears open his shirt while being attacked by creatures
Agent MARBLE drops his gun in response to the attack
Agent MARBLE suffers fatal injuries from creature attack

name: Agent MARBLE Collapses After Creature Attack
description: Agent MARBLE stumbles and falls to the ground, his body ravaged from the swarm of creatures that attacked him. Blood soaks his torn clothing as he lies motionless, breathing weakly. The creatures continue to crawl over and into him, their sharp claws and teeth tearing at his flesh. His gasps grow fainter until he lies still, eyes open and unseeing.
related_events: Agent MARBLE collapses after being fatally wounded

name: Hellboy's Public Debut and Leadership Change
description: Hellboy lounges on a sofa beside Liz, watching dozens of TV monitors in his room. Every screen shows footage from the previous night's news coverage. Hellboy appears on multiple channels, grinning as he tells a reporter he is the strongest being he’s ever fought, winking at the camera. He signs an autograph for a fan, still smiling. Back in the room, he cracks open a beer and turns to Liz. "I think I did good. And I looked good, don't you think, Liz?" Liz rolls her eyes. Abe stands behind the couch, juggling several remote controls. He points at one screen where Manning is surrounded by reporters. "Look—there's Manning," Abe says, turning up the volume. Manning stammers into the microphones, blaming the incident on a "gas pocket." Hellboy laughs. "A gas pocket??!! Ha—! I love it." The door opens. Manning walks in holding a plastic bin overflowing with mail. He glares at the screens and switches them off. "This is a disaster! A disaster, you hear?? Worse than Cheney with a shotgun. Only Liz handled herself with any dignity." Liz glances at Hellboy. "No one asked me anything." Manning pulls out a handful of letters and throws them onto the table. "Don't bother starting a fan club. It's trending five to one against us." "Against?" Hellboy says. Liz picks up a few letters and reads silently. "Unwelcome species... mongrelizing... lower orders... ungodly freaks..." She looks at Hellboy. "Ungodly freaks—? Us?" Manning turns to Hellboy. "You really did it this time. I'm under review. And so are you. As of today, there's a new team leader. We're to meet him at the conference room at 0900—" He checks his watch. "Now."
related_events: Hellboy appears on multiple news channels discussing his strength
Hellboy signs an autograph during media coverage
Hellboy boasts about his media performance to Liz
Liz reacts with annoyance to Hellboy's media appearance
related_occasions: Leadership Transition Briefing

name: Manning Shuts Down the Media Frenzy
description: Abe Sapien, juggling a dozen remote controls, points to one of the monitors where Manning is surrounded by reporters. On screen, Manning stammers out an explanation about a gas pocket. Hellboy laughs, repeating the phrase with disbelief. The door opens and Manning walks in, holding a plastic box overflowing with mail. He switches off all the TVs in disgust. 'This is a disaster,' he says, tossing the mail onto the table. 'Worse than Cheney with a shotgun.'
related_events: Abe Sapien locates Manning on television while juggling remotes
Manning speaks to reporters about a gas pocket
Manning enters the room with a box of mail and turns off the TVs
Manning condemns the situation as a disaster
related_occasions: Leadership Transition Briefing

name: Manning Brings the Fallout
description: Manning enters Hellboy's room holding a plastic box overflowing with mail. He turns off the bank of TV monitors with a swipe of his hand, silencing the news coverage of Hellboy's public appearance. Disgusted, he tosses a handful of letters onto the table. Liz picks up a few and reads some of the messages aloud: "Unwelcome species... mongrelizing... lower orders... ungodly freaks..." Hellboy stares, incredulous. "Ungodly freaks—us?" Manning says the response is overwhelmingly negative—polls, protests, hate mail—and that the Bureau is under review. He turns to Hellboy and announces a new team leader has been appointed. They are to meet in the conference room at 0900. He checks his watch. "Now."
related_events: Manning delivers negative public feedback to the team
Liz reads aloud from hate mail received by the Bureau
Hellboy reacts with disbelief to public backlash
Liz expresses disinterest in media attention
related_occasions: Leadership Transition Briefing

name: Manning Announces Hellboy's Replacement as Team Leader
description: Manning enters Hellboy's room holding a plastic box filled with mail, his expression irritated. He shuts off the bank of television monitors that had been broadcasting news coverage of Hellboy's public appearance. Standing before Hellboy, Liz, and Abe, he declares the situation a disaster and states that Hellboy is being removed as team leader. He announces that a new leader has been appointed and instructs the team to report immediately to the conference room for a briefing. Checking his watch, he emphasizes that the meeting starts now.
related_events: Manning announces Hellboy's removal as team leader
Manning orders the team to report to a leadership meeting
related_occasions: Leadership Transition Briefing

name: Manning Summons Abe from the Aquarium
description: Tom Manning approaches Abe Sapien's aquarium tank and raps his knuckles against the glass. He presses a folder marked TOP SECRET against the surface to get Abe's attention. Abe rises from the warm, bubbled water, removes his breathing apparatus, and joins Manning. The two walk down the hallway as Manning begins to speak, holding out photographs for Abe to see.
related_events: Tom Manning approaches Abe Sapien's tank and signals for attention

name: Manning Shows Abe Suppressed Photos of Hellboy
description: Tom Manning walks through the facility with Abe Sapien, showing him a folder of classified photographs. The images depict Hellboy in public, leaping down a city street, weapon in hand, looking directly at the camera. Abe studies one in particular where Hellboy is smiling. Manning presses the folder against the glass of Abe’s tank, frustrated, commenting on the expense of keeping the photos hidden and how quickly they resurface online. He points to Hellboy’s expression and stance, calling it a provocation. As they continue down the hall, Manning leans toward a security microphone, clearly enunciating his name to unlock a series of steel doors. He mutters that Hellboy is out of control and believes the behavior is intentional—directed at him. Abe replies that Hellboy doesn’t hate him, just that he’s enthusiastic. Manning asks about Hellboy’s relationship with Liz, and Abe responds it’s been the usual mix of good and bad days since they moved in together. Suddenly, an explosion rips through the concrete wall ahead, blasting the final door open. A fireball clears, revealing Hellboy on the floor, his back smoking, flames flickering off his body. He waves casually at Abe and Manning. HELLBOY: Oh, hi Blue. Manning. He pats out a small fire on his arm and steps forward, shouting back over his shoulder. HELLBOY: Well—I’m not afraid of you! You hear?
related_events: Tom Manning speaks to Abe Sapien about suppressed photographs of Hellboy
Abe Sapien reacts to a photograph of Hellboy smiling while brandishing his weapon
Tom Manning voices concern about Hellboy's behavior and personal animosity

name: Manning and Abe Pass Through Security to Reach Hellboy's Room
description: Tom Manning approaches a voice-recognition security panel and speaks clearly into the microphone, enunciating each syllable of his name. The system responds by unlocking a series of heavy steel doors, which slide open one after another with a mechanical hum. Manning and Abe Sapien walk through each doorway as they proceed down the corridor, moving steadily toward Hellboy's quarters.
related_events: Tom Manning uses voice-recognition security system to gain access
Steel doors open sequentially as Tom Manning and Abe Sapien approach Hellboy's room

name: Manning Asks About Hellboy and Liz
description: As they walk down the hall toward Hellboy's room, Tom Manning asks Abe Sapien how things are going between Hellboy and Liz. Abe replies that it's the usual—some good days, some bad days. Just as he speaks, the concrete wall ahead explodes outward in a massive fireball, tearing the final steel door from its hinges. Abe adds, 'Then again, there are the really bad days.' Inside the smoke-filled room, Hellboy lies on the floor, his back smoking and aflame. He pats out a small fire on his arm, stands, and shouts back into the room, 'Well—I'm not afraid of you! You hear??'
related_events: Tom Manning asks Abe Sapien about Hellboy's relationship with Liz
Abe Sapien comments on Hellboy and Liz's relationship having good and bad days
Abe Sapien remarks on the occurrence of really bad days with Hellboy

name: Explosion Reveals Hellboy After Confrontation with Liz
description: As Tom Manning and Abe Sapien approached Hellboy's room, a massive explosion tore through the concrete wall, blasting the final steel door open. The force sent both men diving for cover behind a nearby pillar. When the smoke cleared, Hellboy was visible inside, lying on the floor with his back smoking and flames flickering across it. He casually patted out a small fire on his forearm, stood, and greeted them. From within the room, his voice rang out, yelling at Liz: "Well, I'm not afraid of you! You hear?" Abe and Manning slowly emerged, peering cautiously into the room.
related_events: Explosion destroys the concrete wall and forces open the final steel door
Tom Manning and Abe Sapien take cover behind a pillar during the explosion
Hellboy is revealed lying on the floor with his back smoking and on fire
Hellboy yells at Liz that he is not afraid of her
Abe Sapien and Tom Manning cautiously peer into Hellboy's room after the explosion

description: The truck carrying the BPRD team stops near a cluster of official vehicles beneath the soaring roadbed of the Brooklyn Bridge. name: Abe Sapien's Revelation Amid Media Chaos
description: The truck halts near a cluster of official vehicles beneath the towering roadbed of the Brooklyn Bridge. Protesters hurl eggs as the BPRD team steps out, and Hellboy instinctively shields Liz from the flying debris. A reporter shouts, demanding Hellboy show his powers. Another calls out, mocking Abe Sapien, asking if he’s a mermaid. The crowd laughs. Pressed further, Abe reluctantly places a webbed hand on the reporter’s chest and says, 'You... keep... a large, battery-operated vibrating egg by your bedside.' A shrieking camera crew surges forward, filming frantically. Another reporter turns to Hellboy, yelling, 'You! Demon-man! Will you take a DNA test?' Hellboy snaps back, 'It’s "Hellboy," not "Demon-man."' An egg strikes him. The crowd roars. Johann steps forward to address the chaos, but before he can continue, another egg hits him square in the face. The noise swells, then slowly fades as Johann speaks of the BPRD’s long, silent service and the unseen battles they’ve fought.

name: The Shadowy Figure Claims the Crown
description: The lights go out across the auction house, plunging the room into darkness. A few emergency lights flicker on, casting dim shadows. The Shadowy Figure appears, walking down the aisle toward the stage. He stops before the auctioneer and declares himself the rightful owner of the golden artifact. The auctioneer demands identification and reaches for a phone, calling for security. In response, the Shadowy Figure seizes the ornate arc of gold from the open box. As the auctioneer speaks into the phone, the Shadowy Figure throws a handful of seeds at his feet. The seeds burst into thick, twisting branches that wrap around the auctioneer, pulling him off his feet. The wood coils tighter, lifting him upward as roots surge through the floor and ceiling. Within seconds, the auctioneer vanishes, replaced by a gnarled, compact tree sprouting from the stage. Tiny creatures crawl along its trunk and branches. With a crash, four security guards burst through the side doors, only to be thrown violently into the aisles. Wink enters, carrying two iron boxes marked with a royal seal. He drops them with a clang. From inside, clawed creatures scrabble and mewl, straining against the metal. At a signal from the Shadowy Figure, Wink opens the boxes. The creatures lunge forward as screams fill the room.

name: Prince Nuada's Return and Rebellion
description: Prince Nuada enters the abandoned machine shop where the council of magick families has gathered. He kneels before King Balor, his father, then rises as the king gestures for him to stand. The prince declares he has returned from exile to free their people and reclaim their land and freedom. King Balor accuses him of breaking a truce that has held for centuries. Princess Nuala steps forward, urging adherence to the agreement. Prince Nuada rebukes her, pointing to their surroundings, questioning the honor in living among human ruins and scraps. The king asks if his son’s answer is war, and wonders if their time has simply come to an end. Nuada responds that if they must fall, they will not fade quietly—better to burn than vanish. He raises a golden artifact taken from an auction, causing the crowd to gasp. The king, recognizing it, warns his son against such madness. Nuada confirms his intent. The king, holding his daughter’s hand, mournfully declares he has no choice, and orders the Praetorian Guards to execute his son. Instead, the guards turn and stab the king. The princess screams as the monarch falls dead from his throne. Nuada averts his gaze, then approaches the body and takes the medallion from his father’s chest. He addresses the assembly, offering the clan leaders a choice: join him or die. With the two guards at his back, he joins the medallion with the artifact in his hand. The pieces fuse together, gears and hooks interlocking like living metal, forming an almost complete crown.

description: In the abandoned machine shop turned council chamber, Prince Nuada stands before the gathered heads of the magick families—goblins, trolls, dwarves, and elves. King Balor, the One-armed King of Elfland, sits at the center with Princess Nuala behind him, both wearing matching golden medallions on chains. The Prince enters, the doors closing behind him, and kneels before his father. The King gestures for him to rise and demands to know why he has broken the ancient truce. The Prince answers that he has returned from exile to free their people and reclaim their land. He condemns the humans for their destruction of nature and their disrespect toward the magick races. The Princess steps forward, urging adherence to the agreement, but the Prince rebukes her, pointing to their squalid surroundings as proof of dishonor. The King, overcome with sorrow, suggests their time may be over. The Prince refuses this fate, declaring it better to burn than to fade. He raises a golden artifact taken from an auction, causing the crowd to gasp. The King, recognizing it, warns against madness. The Prince confirms his intent. The King, after a mournful glance at his daughter, orders the Praetorian Guards to execute his son. Instead, the guards turn and stab the King. The Princess screams as the monarch falls dead from his throne. The Prince averts his eyes, then approaches the body and takes the medallion from his father’s chest. He declares that all present must either join him or die. Holding both pieces, they fuse together through intricate, self-assembling mechanisms, forming an almost complete crown.

name: Princess Nuala Escapes to the Hidden Chamber
description: After the Prince's guards stab the King, Princess Nuala turns and flees the council chamber. She darts into a narrow passageway beneath the machine shop, weaving through a labyrinth of damp stone tunnels. Footsteps echo behind her as armed figures give chase. Ahead, she spots a crack in the wall, barely visible in the dim light. She presses against it, slips inside, and pulls a hidden lever. The wall shifts, sending her sliding down a steep chute. The descent ends in a soft pile of dust and old cloth. She rises, breathing heavily, in a secluded stone chamber. Shelves carved into the walls hold rows of ancient books. The air is still. She steps forward, the door sealing shut behind her.
